transformations: Whole-country Shapely coverage_simplify at 0.003 degrees; shared edges simplified together
Round serialized coordinates to 9 decimal places; revalidate every polygon and country coverage
Preserve every source feature, polygon component and hole; fail on loss
Associate modern ADM1 by maximum original ADM2 intersection; retain independent source years and licenses
No country clipping, disputed-territory resolution, island deletion or historical inference
Stable foreign-ISO-shapeID IDs; owner/controller unknown; historical_name/name_source/parent_id empty

license_evidence.source_archives: Fixed 9469f09 sourceData ZIP archive SHA256 and extracted license/meta.txt file SHA256 are recorded per source.
license_evidence.visual_check: IND ADM2 archived provider-page screenshot explicitly states ODbL 1.0 and Pathways attribution; IND ADM1 screenshot explicitly states CC BY 2.5 India. BGD ADM2 archived HDX page states Creative Commons Attribution for Intergovernmental Organisations. PAK ADM2 archive contains a generic Creative Commons public-domain information page; its exact original Wikimedia file page separately confirms worldwide public-domain dedication.
license_evidence.IND_ADM1_current_upstream_license: Current DataMeet README says CC BY 4.0, versus archived pinned source CC BY 2.5 IN; preserve the pinned-source license.

limitations: Source-version coverage only: India 2021 ADM2, Pakistan 2019 ADM2, Bangladesh 2020 ADM2; not a 2026 administrative register or a 1640 boundary reconstruction.
India pinned original ADM2 GeoJSON actually contains 735 features although both API and release metadata say 736. All 735 supplied features are retained; no missing district geometry is invented.
India ADM1 metadata dates its 36-state layer to 2011, versus ADM2 2021; Pakistan ADM1 2019 and Bangladesh ADM1 2015. Spatial associations and source names are reference metadata pending review.

India ADM1 archived release metadata states CC BY 2.5 IN; the upstream DataMeet repository now states CC BY 4.0. Preserve the archived source license and evidence rather than retroactively relabeling the pinned layer.

Pakistan source is substantially coarser than India and Bangladesh. All layers retain original territorial interpretations and may overlap in disputed regions; source_region_code is only a source index.
Different countries are not recut into a seamless composite. Border overlaps and source gaps are retained and quantified; no assertion of sovereignty or actual control follows from these geometries.
Coverage validity checks matching shared edges and absence of internal overlaps; it cannot prove that the original source contains every land area or resolve omitted real-world units.

Historic coastline differences, source romanization, older administrative names and source license obligations remain visible in provenance. Historical names and affiliations require separate evidence.

known_gaps: AFG ADM2仅标Open，公有领域解释未获主源明确条款支持；回退2007年34省，不声称现行县级完整。
NPL为明确过时的2006年75县快照；不是现行77县，也不赋予后来建立的省级归属。
BTN的2020年205 gewog以2010年ADM1作位置参考；相交比例不足95%时上级名称留空。
BTN、MDV的旧HDX地址当前返回404；保留geoBoundaries源档内主源许可截图和声明，不称此次下载为最新HDX数据。
LKA来自2017年OpenStreetMap/Wambacher；原ODbL许可与署名须随改编数据库保留。
MDV的21现代行政环礁多边形主要含水域；绝不能直接当作陆地岛屿轮廓或历史海域控制。
国家之间源版本不同，外部边界可能有重叠或空隙；未据现代参考块改变历史政权面。

database_license: 混合开放来源；各源几何及现代上级关联的原许可逐项保留。印度、斯里兰卡等ODbL派生材料随开放GeoJSON交付。
attribution: geoBoundaries / William & Mary geoLab；原始数据机构、作者与不同许可详见南亚来源表。
historical_policy: 现代国家只用于定位；新增历史名、历史名称证据与历史行政字段均为空，名义归属及实际控制unknown，parent_id为空。不从现代行政引用推定1640疆界。
geometry_policy: 打包保留源对象、稳定ID、几何与岛屿。不同国家源的接缝及争议区域可有重叠；不裁决现代或历史主权。逐国定位时将该国分块绘于上层，便于点选。
editing_id_policy: 沿用各源构建器的固定源ID，不按面积、序号或名称重新生成身份。
